STEP 01

Pick your vessel.

Choose a stable, heat-safe candle vessel. Make room for a little ritual.

STEP 02

Those tiny white grains? That’s your candle. Pour according to the product’s fill guidance. No melting pot needed.

STEP 03

Place the recommended wick in the centre, following the pack’s depth and spacing instructions.

Choose your fragrance. If using a separate scent vial, follow Barkat’s formulation instructions before lighting.

STEP 05

Stay with your glow. When it’s time to refresh, extinguish and let everything cool before handling the wax.

A LITTLE CLARITY

Good
questions.

Before your first pour.

Do I need a melting pot?

No melting pot is needed for the pearl-wax ritual. Pour the pearls into a suitable candle vessel and use the recommended wick, following the instructions on your pack.

How long will my wax last?

Burn time depends on the wax, wick, vessel and use. The final product listing will include tested burn-time guidance; an exact duration isn’t confirmed in this preview.

How do I start a fresh ritual?

Extinguish the candle and let the wax cool completely. Follow the pack instructions for removing spent wax, replacing the wick and refilling.

Can I use any bowl or vase?

Use a stable, heat-safe container suitable for candles. Decorative vessels are not automatically suitable. Follow the product’s vessel and wick instructions.

What about children and pets?

Keep a lit candle out of reach of children and pets, away from drafts and flammable materials. Never leave it unattended. The vessel and melted wax can become hot.

Can I order across India?

This is a storefront preview. Ordering, delivery areas and shipping timelines will be available when the store launches.
